mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dsip_trackers ( user_id, stock_id, conviction_period_years, total_capital_planned, partition_days, deployment_style, base_conviction_score, initial_invested_amount, initial_shares_held, status, active_partition_index, total_capital_invested_so_far, shares_held_so_far, is_fractional_shares_allowed, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{stockId}, #{convictionPeriodYears}, #{totalCapitalPlanned}, #{partitionDays}, #{deploymentStyle}, #{baseConvictionScore}, #{initialInvestedAmount}, #{initialSharesHeld}, #{status}, #{activePartitionIndex}, #{totalCapitalInvestedSoFar}, #{sharesHeldSoFar}, #{isFractionalSharesAllowed}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT tracker_id, user_id, stock_id, conviction_period_years, total_capital_planned, partition_days, deployment_style, base_conviction_score, initial_invested_amount, initial_shares_held, status, active_partition_index, total_capital_invested_so_far, shares_held_so_far, is_fractional_shares_allowed, created_at FROM dsip_trackers WHERE tracker_id = #{trackerId}
SELECT * FROM dsip_trackers WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT t.tracker_id, t.user_id, t.stock_id, t.conviction_period_years, t.total_capital_planned, t.partition_days, t.deployment_style, t.base_conviction_score, t.initial_invested_amount, t.initial_shares_held, t.status, t.active_partition_index, t.total_capital_invested_so_far, t.shares_held_so_far, t.is_fractional_shares_allowed, t.created_at, s.stock_symbol, s.stock_name, s.last_date_market_closing_price, s.stock_type FROM dsip_trackers t INNER JOIN stocks s ON t.stock_id = s.id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dsip_trackers WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND stock_id = #{stockId})
mapper.update: UPDATE dsip_trackers SET deployment_style = #{deploymentStyle}, base_conviction_score = #{baseConvictionScore}, active_partition_index = #{activePartitionIndex}, status = #{status}, total_capital_planned = #{totalCapitalPlanned}, conviction_period_years = #{convictionPeriodYears}, partition_days = #{partitionDays}, total_capital_invested_so_far = #{totalCapitalInvestedSoFar}, shares_held_so_far = #{sharesHeldSoFar} WHERE tracker_id = #{trackerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dsip_partitions ( tracker_id, partition_index, expected_partition_days, partition_capital_allocated, capital_invested_so_far, no_of_shares_bought, successful_growth_count, avg_negative_deviation, max_negative_deviation, negative_deviation_count, partition_end_date, status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{trackerId}, #{partitionIndex}, #{expectedPartitionDays}, #{partitionCapitalAllocated}, #{capitalInvestedSoFar}, #{noOfSharesBought}, #{successfulGrowthCount}, #{avgNegativeDeviation}, #{maxNegativeDeviation}, #{negativeDeviationCount}, #{partitionEndDate}, #{status}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM dsip_partitions WHERE tracker_id = #{trackerId} ORDER BY partition_index ASC

SELECT partition_id, tracker_id, partition_index, expected_partition_days, partition_capital_allocated, capital_invested_so_far, no_of_shares_bought, successful_growth_count, avg_negative_deviation, max_negative_deviation, negative_deviation_count, partition_end_date, status, created_at FROM dsip_partitions WHERE tracker_id = #{trackerId} AND status = 1 /* PartitionStatus.ACTIVE */ ORDER BY partition_index DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE dsip_partitions SET capital_invested_so_far = #{capitalInvestedSoFar}, no_of_shares_bought = #{noOfSharesBought}, successful_growth_count = #{successfulGrowthCount}, avg_negative_deviation = #{avgNegativeDeviation}, max_negative_deviation = #{maxNegativeDeviation}, negative_deviation_count = #{negativeDeviationCount}, status = #{status}, partition_end_date = #{partitionEndDate} WHERE partition_id = #{partitionId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM dsip_partitions WHERE tracker_id = #{trackerId} AND status = 2 /* PartitionStatus.COMPLETED */ ORDER BY partition_index ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dsip_executions ( tracker_id, partition_id, lock_in_percentage, conviction_override, executed_amount, execution_price, created_at ) VALUES ( #{trackerId}, #{partitionId}, #{lockInPercentage}, #{convictionOverride, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{executedAmount}, #{executionPrice}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT t.tracker_id, t.user_id, t.stock_id, t.conviction_period_years, t.total_capital_planned, t.partition_days, t.deployment_style, t.base_conviction_score, t.initial_invested_amount, t.initial_shares_held, t.status, t.active_partition_index, t.total_capital_invested_so_far, t.shares_held_so_far, t.is_fractional_shares_allowed, t.created_at, s.stock_symbol, s.stock_name, s.last_date_market_closing_price, s.stock_type FROM dsip_trackers t JOIN stocks s ON t.stock_id = s.id WHERE t.tracker_id = #{trackerId} AND t.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT created_at as date, executed_amount as executedAmount, execution_price as executedPrice FROM dsip_executions WHERE tracker_id = #{trackerId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
